description: Add opencode as a supported AI coding tool, deprecate Amp, and update all documentation to reflect the new tool landscape (Claude Code + opencode).

userStories.title: Update AGENTS.md with full Ralph agent prompt
userStories.description: As an opencode user, I want AGENTS.md to contain the full Ralph agent instructions so opencode picks them up automatically when running in my project.
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md contains the complete Ralph agent prompt (same content/structure as CLAUDE.md but adapted for opencode)
Progress report format does NOT include the Amp thread URL line (Thread: https://ampcode.com/threads/$AMP_CURRENT_THREAD_ID)
The file references AGENTS.md instead of CLAUDE.md where appropriate (e.g. 'Update AGENTS.md files if you discover reusable patterns')
Stop condition, quality requirements, and all other sections are present and complete
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add opencode support to ralph.sh
userStories.description: As a user, I want to run ./ralph.sh --tool opencode so Ralph can drive opencode the same way it drives Claude Code.
acceptanceCriteria: --tool opencode is a valid option in ralph.sh
When --tool opencode is selected, ralph.sh invokes opencode with: OPENCODE_PERMISSION='{"*":"allow"}' opencode run "<prompt>" for non-interactive autonomous operation
The prompt passed to opencode instructs it to read AGENTS.md and prd.json (e.g. 'Read AGENTS.md and prd.json and complete the next user story')
Error message updated to: "Must be 'claude' or 'opencode'."
Iteration log line shows the correct tool name
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Deprecate Amp in ralph.sh
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to remove Amp as a supported tool so the codebase reflects the current supported tools (Claude Code and opencode).
acceptanceCriteria: Default tool in ralph.sh changed from 'amp' to 'opencode'
'amp' removed from the valid tool list in ralph.sh
The if [[ "$TOOL" == "amp" ]] branch removed from ralph.sh
prompt.md is deleted
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update README.md and AGENTS.md for opencode support

acceptanceCriteria: Prerequisites section: replace Amp CLI with opencode, keep Claude Code
Setup section: replace Amp-specific copy instructions with opencode equivalents (copy AGENTS.md instead of prompt.md)
'Configure Amp auto-handoff' section removed
Workflow section: command examples show --tool opencode and --tool claude (no --tool amp)
Key Files table: replace prompt.md row with AGENTS.md as 'Prompt template for opencode'
References section: replace Amp docs link with opencode docs link (https://opencode.ai)
AGENTS.md Commands section updated to remove Amp references and show correct ralph.sh usage
